settings.question: How often will you email me?
settings.answer: A few emails a month during the season, fewer while the tractor hibernates. No spam. We never share your email, not even for money.

settings.question: How do I unsubscribe?
settings.answer: Tap “Unsubscribe” at the bottom of any email from The Evil List. One tap and you’re off. You can also turn it off in your account.

settings.question: Do you send texts?
settings.answer: No. The Evil List is email only. We don’t ask for your phone number and we don’t send texts.
